sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

lines=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
Ncells=set()
for r in range(10,64):
    for c in range(64):
        if lines[r][c]=='N': Ncells.add((r,c))
seen=set(); clusters=[]
for cell in Ncells:
    if cell in seen: continue
    stack=[cell]; comp=[]; seen.add(cell)
    while stack:
        x,y=stack.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            n=(x+dx,y+dy)
            if n in Ncells and n not in seen:
                seen.add(n); stack.append(n)
    clusters.append(comp)
for comp in sorted(clusters,key=lambda c:(min(a for a,b in c),min(b for a,b in c))):
    rs=[a for a,b in comp]; cs=[b for a,b in comp]
    print("blob rows",min(rs),max(rs),"cols",min(cs),max(cs),"center",(min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
